$comment: Maps a release version to the work it carries, so a reader can tell which
build contains which journey. The published artifact is the GitHub tag
archive consumed by Jongtae/homebrew-agentos Formula/agentos.rb; the
formula is not in this repository by an explicit earlier migration

published.carries: Pre-EPIC-PA1. Contains no PA1 child: no Gmail connector, no `agentos service`, no PA1 connector contract, no memory service.
published.observed: Tapped and installed locally at the time of writing (`brew list --versions agentos` -> `agentos 1.0.4`). Local operating observation, not a clean-machine install.

unpublished.why_no_checksum: The GitHub tag archive does not exist until the tag is pushed, and its gzip output is not byte-reproducible from a local `git archive`. A fabricated checksum would produce a formula that reviews as valid and installs nothing.
unpublished.carries: EPIC-PA1 #386 children: #387 connector seam, #388 install/background lifecycle, #389 Gmail read/search, #390 Calendar policy core, #391 public research, #392 memory candidates, #382 web management, #393 Telegram capability handoff, #394 integration.

journeys.J3: covered offline - live Google OAuth owner_validation_pending

unpublished.not_claimed: No live Google, OpenRouter or Telegram operation has been observed for any journey.
